recent: Tiong Nam 在 2026 年 11 月公布 2026 年 9 月止季度业绩，净利转为 RM10.34m，物流业务增长带动营收。同期大股东 Teo Kwee Hock 多次申报股权变动，公司亦持续进行股份回购。
notable: 公布 2026 年 9 月止季度业绩，净利 RM10.34m，物流业务盈利增长。
大股东 Teo Kwee Hock 于 9 月至 11 月期间多次申报股权变动。
公司于 10 月至 11 月进行股份回购。
risks: 创办人妻子 Yong Kwee Lian 不再是大股东，涉及家族股权重组。
董事 Ong Yoong Nyock 及 Yong Kwee Lian 申报权益变动。

recent_en: Tiong Nam reported a net profit of RM10.34m for the quarter ended September 2026, driven by logistics growth. Substantial shareholder Teo Kwee Hock filed multiple changes in interest, and the company continued share buybacks.
notable_en: Announced quarterly results for the period ended September 2026 with net profit of RM10.34m, driven by logistics earnings growth.
Substantial shareholder Teo Kwee Hock filed multiple changes in interest from September to November.
The company conducted share buybacks in October and November.
risks_en: Founder's wife Yong Kwee Lian ceased to be a substantial shareholder amid family share restructuring.
Director Ong Yoong Nyock and Yong Kwee Lian filed changes in interest.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended June 2026, revenue was RM268.731m, up 15.0% QoQ and 13.8% YoY; net income was RM13.405m, down 29.3% QoQ but up 236.5% YoY; net margin was 5.0% versus 8.1% in the prior quarter.
